description: Free. Named in honour of Margaret Hamilton (1936–2026), who led the Apollo flight software team: under overload a system keeps the most important work, drops the rest and says what it dropped. Returns the components of Orb Studio's broadcast in priority order (music, voice, host links, sensor news, radar news, regional interviews, self-check) with state full / degraded / stale / down / unknown, what was dropped, why, and when it was last updated. Use it before relying on Orb Studio data to know what is fresh.
name: get_hamilton
title: Hamilton sensor: what in Orb Studio works fully, what was dropped to keep the main things running, and why
